name: Andrei Villanueva
title: Aerospace Engineer
about: Aerospace engineer with 7 years of experience in propulsion systems, structural analysis, and flight dynamics. I thrive at the boundary between rigorous mathematics and real-world hardware — from initial concept through test campaign. Currently focused on small-satellite launch vehicle development and in-space propulsion.

experience.title: Senior Propulsion Engineer
experience.description: Lead propulsion system design for a next-generation 1U Hall-effect thruster. Managed a 4-person subsystem team through PDR and CDR milestones. Conducted over 200 hours of vacuum chamber test campaigns and reduced thrust-specific impulse variance by 18% through nozzle geometry optimization.

experience.title: Propulsion & Structures Engineer
experience.description: Performed structural margin analysis for Ariane 6 payload fairing components using NASTRAN and custom Python post-processing pipelines. Collaborated with ESA on propellant management device (PMD) qualification testing for the Vega-C upper stage.

experience.title: Graduate Research Assistant
experience.company: TU Delft — Space Systems Engineering Lab
experience.description: Thesis on hybrid rocket motor regression-rate modelling using machine learning surrogates. Experimental work on paraffin-based fuel grains; developed an open-source Python toolkit (HybridSim) with 180+ GitHub stars.
